articles.summary: ATLANTA, Ga. (January 15, 2025) — MaxHSA, a gamified Health Savings Account (HSA) engagement platform developed by Benegames, Inc., today announced a strategic partnership with Avidia Health, a leading HSA administrator, to make MaxHSA’s innovative savings solution available to Avidia accountholders nationwide.
